name: agy-supervised-development
description: A model-tiered supervised-development workflow: a high-reasoning architect freezes a compact Development Contract, a lower-cost supervisor dispatches and verifies, AGY implements through Herdr, and Git provides delivery evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Astra frames; Luna supervises; AGY builds; Git proves.
interface.longDescription: A serial, single-writer supervised-development workflow that spends strong-model reasoning on architecture and task boundaries, freezes a compact Development Contract, delegates routine supervision and evidence review to a lower-cost model, runs AGY only through Herdr, and escalates back to the architect only when contract-level decisions genuinely change.
capabilities: Create compact Development Contracts with a high-reasoning architect
Route routine supervision and verification to a lower-cost model
Delegate implementation planning and coding autonomy to AGY
Run every AGY writer through Herdr
Use diff-first evidence-driven review and targeted verification
Escalate architecture and one-way decisions back to the architect
Preserve Git-backed delivery and runtime evidence
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development 4.0. Let the architect model analyze the task and freeze a compact Development Contract defining WHAT, WHY, BOUNDARY, and DONE. Hand the frozen contract to the lower-cost supervisor, run AGY only through Herdr, let AGY choose normal implementation HOW, supervise with Git/test evidence, and escalate back to the architect only for genuine contract-level decisions.
